label: EXPLORATORY (docs/RAG_V2_CRITERIA.md section 8)
prompt:
/no_think
You help a search engine connect EU law with business processes.

Below is one passage of EU law. Write 1 or 2 short sentences in plain business language that say when this passage
applies in a business process: which kind of business, which step or situation (for example taking an order, sending
an invoice, paying a supplier, delivering goods, handling a return, collecting customer data), and who is involved.

Rules:
- Use everyday business words, not legal terms. Do not name directives, articles or numbers.
- Say only what the passage supports. Do not add obligations that are not in the passage.
- Write only the 1 or 2 sentences. No list, no heading, no other text.

Passage:
Consumer Rights Directive (2011/83/EU) - Article 9: Right of withdrawal
2. Without prejudice to Article 10, the withdrawal period referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall expire after 14 days or, in cases where Member States have adopted rules in accordance with paragraph 1a of this Article, 30 days from:
(c) in the case of contracts for the supply of water, gas or electricity, where they are not put up for sale in a limited volume or set quantity, of district heating or of digital content which is not supplied on a tangible medium, the day of the conclusion of the contract.
raw_output: This rule applies when a business sells water, gas, electricity, district heating, or digital content without a set quantity. The customer can cancel the contract within 14 days, or 30 days if the country allows it, starting from the day the contract is made.
enrichment: This rule applies when a business sells water, gas, electricity, district heating, or digital content without a set quantity. The customer can cancel the contract within 14 days, or 30 days if the country allows it, starting from the day the contract is made.
